verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is one community comment from a 2018 thread referring to 'on-prem instances' of Jira, which implies the core product has been self-hosted. No first-party documentation in the pack describes a self-hosted edition, how to install it, or whether it is still offered. The cloud sandboxes and developer sites are Atlassian-hosted, so they do not count as self-hosting. missing for 10: first-party documentation of a self-hosted or on-prem edition, installation and deployment guidance, confirmation of current availability and licensing, and recent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: On-prem instances that are under-resourced or keep Lucene indexes on networked storage perform badly.
